{{Top|leg}}
'''Koti''' were young [[Kriek]]s. While the leaders of Kriek tribes rarely strayed from their villages, koti were given license to roam wherever they pleased as long as they remained within the tribal borders.<ref name="Scout">{{JournalCite|13|Scouts' Dispatch}}</ref>
